instruction: Please navigate to the Apple Human Interface Guidelines page on searching at https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/searching and save the main content to a document file. Capture the content from the 'Searching' section up to but not including the 'Resources' section. Save the document as "search_guidelines.docx" on the desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Apple HIG searching page and saving content to docx, excluding Resources section. Evaluator checks for searching-specific keywords (search field, search token, scope bar, search suggestions), verifies Resources section keywords are NOT present, minimum 500 words and 15 paragraphs, and validates expected section headings (Best practices, Platform considerations). Custom getter extracts document content and structure, custom metric validates keyword presence, boundary condition compliance, and document completeness.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 20% word count (>=500 words), 15% paragraph count (>=15 paragraphs), 35% required keywords (5 searching-specific terms), 20% excluded keywords (Resources section not included), 10% section headings (Best practices, Platform considerations)

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies content source using searching-specific keywords: 'search field', 'search token', 'scope bar', 'search suggestions' - these terms are unique to the searching page
Boundary condition properly verified: excluded_keywords check ensures Resources section content (e.g., 'Resources', 'Related', 'Developer documentation', 'Videos') is NOT present in the document
Content completeness verified: min_word_count (500) and min_paragraph_count (15) are reasonable thresholds to ensure meaningful content capture from the Apple HIG searching page
Section heading validation: Checks for 'Best practices' and 'Platform considerations' which should be present in the searching page content
Proper scoring breakdown: 20% word count, 15% paragraph count, 35% required keywords, 20% excluded keywords, 10% section headings - well-distributed and appropriate weights
Metric parameter handling is correct: Directly accesses expected.get('required_keywords') since framework passes rules dict directly when expected.type='rule'
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider adding more required keywords if the actual Apple HIG searching page has other distinctive terms to increase confidence in content source verification
Minor: The evaluator cannot verify the actual URL source (practical limitation of post-execution verification), but the keyword-based approach is a reasonable proxy for verifying correct content
